firstMessage.rawMarkdown: Since we know how bad with respect to capability E4B is, has anyone tried to use a LoRA adapter to fine-tune the model? If yes, was it successful in running on the submission scorer, since it looks like The LoRA approach doesn't work with the current scorer infrastructure. The scorer's PEFT can't handle Gemma4ClippableLinear (or even the inner .linear modules in some cases).
